attestations.text: CHÊNG Chih-lung 鄭芝龍 (T. 飛黃, 飛虹), 1604–1661, Nov. 24, pirate and adventurer of the Ming-Ch'ing transitional period, was a native of Nan-an, Fukien. He was the eldest son of Chêng Shao-tsu 鄭紹組, a petty official of Ch'üan-chou.
